Hi Aanya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from my side so we’re aligned before the next call:

- Primary goal: reduce search + summarization latency for clinician queries while keeping embedding/update costs predictable.
- Success criteria (proposed): 95th percentile generation latency <= 300ms at expected trial throughput (peak ~250 qps), semantic search MRR lift +15% vs current baseline, and no PII leakage in stored prompts/embeddings.
- Constraints: HealthGrid needs data isolation for PHI-bound queries and a short proof window (3 weeks) with minimal ops overhead.

Next steps I propose: schedule a two-part session next week — a 45-minute product demo focused on UX/latency and a 60-minute technical deep dive to lock the trial plan (endpoints, auth, prompt sets, success metrics). The technical deep dive will include our infra/privsec folks so we can cover VPC/KMS questions.

Two slots that work on our side:
- Thursday, 2027-07-08 14:00–15:00 PT (preferred)
- Wednesday, 2027-07-06 10:00–11:00 PT

If neither works, send a couple of windows that do and I’ll coordinate.

Prep from you: if you can share a short prioritized prompt set (5–10 canonical queries) and a sample doc or two we can align the trial metrics faster. I attached a short trial-plan outline and our security questionnaire to get the ball rolling.

I’ll have Marissa cover infra/ops in the deep dive and Aditya join for the product demo for prompt engineering specifics.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.
